entities.name: Radomir
entities.description: A Boros legionnaire and guildmage from Sunhome on Ravnica.

entities.name: Ambroz Benakov
entities.description: A pontiff in the area who was secretly responsible for kidnapping and extortion.

entities.name: Tanek
entities.description: A thief who stole Benakov's coin purse and was recruited by Radomir as a spy.

entities.name: Boros Legion
entities.description: The Boros military guild to which Radomir belongs.

entities.name: Sunhome
entities.description: The Boros fortress from which Radomir hails.

events.summary: Radomir, assigned to watch rising tensions, sees the thief Tanek trip the pontiff and steal his coin purse, and pursues him.
events.quote: Radomir witnessed the thief Tanek trip the pontiff up

events.summary: Tanek reveals that Pontiff Benakov was responsible for the kidnapping and extortion; Radomir recruits Tanek as a spy and pays him two gold.
events.quote: Radomir recruited Tanek as a spy

relations.quote: Radomir is a Boros legionnaire and guildmage
Radomir recruited Tanek as a spy

relations.note: Radomir learned Benakov was behind the extortion.
relations.quote: it was none other than Pontiff Benakov himself who was responsible
